list.title: Products
list.lede: Every Line Tech instrument in one place — Mass Flow Controllers, Mass Flow Meters, low-pressure EPC, and accessories across analogue, digital, specialized, and LEPC lines.

finderCta.title: Find your controller
finderCta.lede: Pick a gas and flow rate — we'll match it to the right MFC or MFM.

analogue.title: Analogue series
analogue.lede: The longest-running Line Tech line. 0–5 VDC / 4–20 mA signal, ±1% F.S. accuracy, 18 models from 0.01 to 5,000 slpm.

digital.title: Digital series
digital.lede: 8-point linearization. ±0.25% F.S. accuracy. Sub-second response. RS-485 / Modbus RTU.

specialized.title: Specialized series
specialized.lede: Explosion-proof (EX) variants for hazardous and demanding environments.

lepc.title: LEPC pressure controller
lepc.lede: Electronic Pressure Controller for low-pressure applications between 0.1 and 6 barA, with ±0.5% F.S. accuracy.

productFinder.heading: Find your controller
productFinder.lede: Tell us your gas and target flow rate. We'll match it to the right Line Tech MFC, MFM, or EPC and convert to N₂-equivalent automatically.

results.prompt: Enter a flow rate above to see matches.
results.heading: {count, plural, =0 {No matches} =1 {1 match} other {# matches}}
results.empty: No products fit those requirements. Try a wider series filter or contact us.
results.specialtyWarning: This gas typically needs a specialty seal (Kalrez/Teflon/Metal). Verify seal material with sales before ordering.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.sub: Built for precision gas processes — long-term stability, fast response, traceable accuracy.

specs.heading: Technical specifications
specs.sub: All values measured at 25°C with N₂ as the reference gas, unless otherwise noted.

dimensions.heading: Outline dimensions
dimensions.sub: Units in millimeters. Dimensions shown are for the 1/4" VCR fitting variant.
dimensions.caption: Flow direction left → right. Model name engraved on the top face.
dimensions.note: Figure is for reference only. Refer to the official CAD drawing for confirmed dimensions.

downloads.heading: Downloads
downloads.sub: Latest revisions only. Request historical files via the contact form.

requestDocs.heading: Need manuals or CAD drawings?
requestDocs.body: Technical documents are available on request. Send us the model and your application, and we'll respond within one business day.
